versions.content: The storage of keys resp. their elements shall be initiated only when KEYSETVALID” is started, either by a call to Crypto_KeySetValid() or to Crypto_ProcessJob() with primitive service CRYPTO_KEYSETVALID or CRYPTO_KEYSETINVALID set. Thus, key element storage in NVM shall not be initiated on a call to Crypto_KeyElementSet() or similar operation. The storage operation shall only take place if the validation was successfully finished and the operation returns E_OK (either directly by a synchronous call or asynchronously through the callback).
